EffectDescription.Key_mf_chorus_echo: Deal {Number} damage; if you have 3+ cards in hand, deal 4 more.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_swarm_pull: Draw {Number} card(s); if your discard pile has 5+ cards, draw 1 more.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_chain_finish: Deal {Number} damage plus a quarter of your discard pile (up to 6).
EffectDescription.Key_mf_shield_bash: Deal half your Block as damage (or {Number} if you have none), then lose all Block.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_bulwark_pray: Heal for a third of your Block (at least {Number}).
EffectDescription.Key_mf_last_bastion: Gain {Number} Block. At half health or below, gain 6 more Block and heal 4.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_molt_shell: Lose all Block and draw {Number} card(s).
EffectDescription.Key_mf_feast: Draw {Number} card(s), discard 1 at random, gain 1 Purple mana.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_glut: Discard {Number} random card(s); gain 1 Black mana for each.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_renew: Heal {Number}. If you have 2 or fewer cards, draw 2 instead.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_void_tithe: Lose {Number} health, gain 8 Block and 2 Purple mana.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_king_decree: Deal {Number} damage (+1 per 2 cards in hand) and apply 2 Bleed to the opponent.
